name: TypeScript Enum
description: Per-Enum file: emits a Zod enum schema plus a TypeScript literal-union type. One file per Enum declared anywhere in the model. Colocated with entity schemas under target/src/schemas/ so per-entity schemas can resolve `import { FooSchema } from './FooSchema'` without an extra folder hop.

children.content:
valueLiterals = (values || []).map(function (v) { return "'" + v.name + "'"; }).join(', ');
valueNames = (values || []).map(function (v) { return v.name; });

import { z } from 'zod'

export const {{pascalCase name}}Values = [{{{valueLiterals}}}] as const

export const {{pascalCase name}}Schema = z.enum({{pascalCase name}}Values)

export type {{pascalCase name}} = z.infer<typeof {{pascalCase name}}Schema>
